title: 关于《古诗十九首》中的爱情
title_en: On Love in the 'Nineteen Old Poems'
excerpt: 教科书希望我们“从一而终”，把爱驯化成秩序。但《古诗十九首》不是，它脱离了伦理角度，从个体出发书写情感与存在。
excerpt_en: The textbook wants us to be 'faithful to the end' and tame love into order. But 'Nineteen Old Poems' is not like that. It writes about emotions and existence from an individual perspective, detached from ethical angles.
